prompt.alinti: Exposed database credentials, public.env files, hard-coded API keys or secrets, weak or missing authentication, missing server-side auth checks, users able to access other users' data, open or overly permissive database read and write permissions, misconfigured Firebase, Supabase, S3 or storage buckets, admin routes left unprotected, debug pages or developer tools exposed in prod, build logs leaking secrets, verbose error messages leaking stack traces or internal details, secrets or sensitive data committed to Git or Git history, secrets involved in front-end JavaScript, client-side only security checks, missing input validation, SQL injection, no SQL injection.

yontem.ne: Geliştirme aşamasında ve üretimde yaygın olarak görülen 36 adet güvenlik ihlali türünü listeler.
yontem.alinti: Exposed database credentials, public.env files, hard-coded secrets, weak or missing authentication, missing server-side auth checks, cross-user data access, open database permissions, misconfigured Firebase/Supabase/S3, unprotected admin routes, exposed debug tools, secret-leaking logs, verbose error messages, Git/Git history secrets, front-end secrets, client-side-only security, missing input validation, SQL injection vulnerabilities.

akis.ne: Kamera ekranında 36 adet güvenlik ihlali türünü sıralar ve her birini kısa bir açıklama ile ekranda gösterir.
akis.alinti: Ekran OCR'sında '1.Exposed DB credentials', '2.Hardcoded secrets', '3.Public.env files', '4.Weak auth', '5.Missing Authz check', '6.Cross-user access', '7.Open DB permissions', '8.Misconfigured Firebase/Supabase/S3', '9.Unprotected admin routes', '10.Exposed prod debug tools', '11.Build logs leaking secrets', '12.Verbose error messages', '13.Secrets in Git/Git history', '14.Secrets in front-end JS', '15.Client-side-only security', '16.Missing input validation', '17.SQL injection', '18.No SQL injection' gibi listeler.

yazi: 36 adet güvenlik ihlali türü, 'built app' yazısı, 'In 36 seconds' metni, 'Exposed' başlığı, 'securitychecksforyourAl-' yazısı, '00:00.46' gibi zaman damgaları, '1213141516718' gibi rastgele karakterler, 'builtapp', 'missing authz check', 'crossuseraccess', 'misconfig', 'debugtools', 'prod', 'client-only', 'inputvalidation', 'SQLinjection' gibi teknik terimler.
